$comment: Must match timing.DEFAULT_PROFILE. These values shape where a speech
offset lands, so they are part of the manipulation and must be frozen
by the research director before collection.
max_onset_delay_ms is the candidate engineering target from goal.md
section 7. It is a proposal, not a research-approved tolerance.
blocking=false implements the decision to measure the configuration at
the start of every session, record it, and let the session proceed. Set
blocking=true for participant collection once a tolerance is frozen.
check_capture opens the live microphone. It is off by default and must
be switched on deliberately; the researcher view has to show that the
microphone is live while it runs.
No frozen materials exist. M2 produces stimuli/manifest.json with ten
reviewed assets and their hashes; the six candidate stories in
EXPERIMENT_STORIES_DRAFT.md are drafts, not validated stimuli.
Authoritative session files must live in a university-managed
research-data directory outside this repository and outside any served
web root (goal.md section 10). No path is configured, so no session can
write real data yet; the preflight reports that as NOT_RUN rather than
defaulting to somewhere convenient.
